CURIOUS? GOOD.

A few things
you might be wondering.

Still have a question?

Do I need to commit to a schedule?

No. The concept supports booking lessons when you want, with no subscription or ongoing commitment.

How are tutors vetted?

The proposed platform includes background checks, subject tests and a teaching demonstration. “8% acceptance” is an illustrative claim, not verified vetting of these fictional profiles.

What if my tutor isn’t the right fit?

The concept offers a free first 30-minute lesson and a rematch or refund policy for eligible paid sessions. This demo does not deliver lessons or transactions.

Can I use BrightMinds for my child?

A parent dashboard is part of the product concept. This static homepage offers only local tutor and booking previews.

What technology would I need?

A computer or tablet, webcam and stable internet would be needed for the proposed browser classroom. The demo never requests camera or microphone access.
